name: Church Mothers
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of mothers within the family and community, calling for honor and respect toward them as commanded by God (Exodus 20:12; Deuteronomy 5:16; Leviticus 19:3). Mothers are depicted as key instructors in godly wisdom and law, whose teachings should not be forsaken (Proverbs 1:8). The nurturing and training provided by mothers are foundational for a child's lifelong faithfulness (Proverbs 22:6), and their strength and honor are celebrated as enduring virtues (Proverbs 31:25).
